notes.title: Explorer mode
notes.content:
[h2][b]Explorer[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=M8-EVhjCBVE;full][/previewyoutube]

One of two main game modes are ready now! (Second will be at full release of game)
At this mode progress will be saved after each galaxy.

1. Map for explorer mode.
Global explorer map sharing between profiles, So you can complete different galaxies with different profiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/03ee3683e691bf846636c0b8e4679c97d014d182.png[/img]


2. Every point on map contains mini galaxy to explore. Every galaxy contains special enemies with constant force.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/85efdea2e07bf983ef0150e415e70d10ce10f686.gif[/img]


3. Progress will be save after every galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/ac409b2d1857da850bf790e2d34ba4a2bff4ffb0.png[/img]

4. Each galaxy contains mini boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/029896150e360b9061e24605d15ab2ac1ab54d29.png[/img]

notes.title: Devblog 3
notes.content:
[u][h3]Physics[/h3][/u]
Asteroids now can be moved to any location. You will have several options to do it. So you can save your ships or damage enemies with them or maybe hide something.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/bfe2c94747aa39b32a32b2607b0f8b81fa2fb2aa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/8eb2882e418ccf08f6d0afbce26438040d97e4d9.gif[/img]

[h3][u]Commander guns variants[/u][/h3]
All main ship gun now have 2 ways of upgrades at last level. Ways are really different so you will have more tactical options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/f056e637a2d9e7cf9849f64cc4517a2cead210b8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/3576cdd57ad051cd4bddeecdb86462d050d50ddd.gif[/img]

[u][h3]New battlefield[/h3][/u]
Because of asteroids movable now arena also changed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/7328a2fcfd45eb55b624ff51d09d11936a2c7d76.png[/img]

[u][h3]Turrets[/h3][/u]
This is static guns with 360 degree aiming sector. Turrets have to options: they can be linked to main ship, or to static platforms. And some battles now looks like a fortress battles, when 1 side at defence and other attacking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/0629fd7d2af0026095ab8431868143bef7443ca3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/afa60fa42ba1731354f9a2858f6dd893b755da7c.png[/img]

[u][h3]Ships lights[/h3][/u]
Minor upgrade, but big for me: Ship now have color (green or red) lights, so player can easily recognise side of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/e4cd0d816361b4d16d6582f004c4472fc0176b27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36413499/d8c29168c5b258ed7ab21ec26c82af24c87b5add.png[/img]

Future plans:
1. Support weapon.
2. Commander ships, passive options.
3. Reinforcement mechanics
4. Balancing and tests
